summary: Verified Multicap Mom Quality 50 SIP scenario (2021-01-01 -> 2026-09-29 latest, 3Y horizon) on the preview URL. PRICE: Avg Rolling 19.84%, Full-Period XIRR 9.37%. TRI: Avg Rolling 21.13%, Full-Period XIRR 10.59%. Both match E1's independent recompute (19.84/9.37, 21.13/10.58). 66 rolling windows. Rolling avg is far above full-period XIRR, which is expected (they are different metrics) and not a bug. Total Invested is Rs34.50L = 138 x Rs25,000 (I recomputed the 138 1st/15th dates). Final Value 45.18L / 46.79L matches the stated XIRR when re-solved independently (45.20L / 46.81L, within rounding). No NaN or em-dash placeholders in any row. Both new notes (rollCompNote, fpMeta) render, are visible and contain the requested wording in SIP mode. No console errors or page errors.

issues: #rollCompNote (class 'sub') renders in a large ~16px body font, much bigger than the small muted #meta/#fpMeta notes, so it looks heavier than the table. Consider using the small muted 'meta' styling.
